why_not_compared: the nightly check can read the page's own data files (econvitals.org/tools/inequality-explorer/data.json and data-full.json), but they store each series as a list in the order of the file's years, which the check names by position (0, 1, 2 …), while this script's outputs are keyed by year and income group, so no value lines up; comparing nightly needs replicate.py to also write its values keyed by that position (or the check to name list positions by the file's years). replicate.py compares itself with both page files whenever it runs: 410,310 numbers, largest difference 1e-16 (rerun 2026-11-25)
